Hi Scott,

You're right, none of those three have shipped yet. Your BS-4 went out on its own and the Power Kit, the Miner Duster and the Overclocking package are still sitting at our warehouse waiting on stock, so nothing was missing from the miner's box. They ship separately, at no extra cost to you, and you'll get tracking for them.

The O. package is a Mean Well LRS-350-12 power supply, a thermal paste syringe, nine aluminium heatsinks and two alcohol cleaning pads, so there was nothing extra to find in the first box.

On dates, the Miner Duster ships November 16 and the Overclocking package November 29. The P. Kit I don't want to guess at, the date I have on it is stale, so a colleague is picking that up today and will confirm it with you in this thread.

The Harlo OS diagnostics and 3 month RMA line on your order is a service, not a shipped item, so there's nothing in the post for that one.

The broken frame piece is still with the team and they'll come back to you on it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
